theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  let f := fun x => Φ ↑x
  have h0 : ∀ n ≠ 0, |f n| ≤ (↑n) ^ (↑s.re - 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 : |Φ ↑n| ≤ 1 := by
      apply norm_le_one
      exact complex.norm_map_zero
    rw [pow_sub] at h1
    refine le_rpow_of_le_one _ _ _
    · exact h1
    · exact lt_trans (lt_iff_lt_zero'.mp (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)) (by norm_num : ↑s.re - 1 > 0)
  apply LSeriesSummable_of_isBigO_rpow f ↑s.re h0
  apply LSeriesSummable_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt_re (lt_of_le_of_lt (LSeriesSummable.abscissaOfAbsConv_le (by assumption)) hs)
